description: AI-powered last-mile delivery platform that helps enterprise shippers optimize routes, engage customers, and reduce delivery failures. Used by furniture, appliance, and grocery retailers.
Global logistics technology company providing route planning, last-mile delivery, and supply chain visibility solutions. Trusted by thousands of companies for delivery management.
AI-based dispatching and route optimization platform for enterprises. Automates decisions for first, middle, and last-mile logistics with measurable cost and quality improvements.
AI-powered planning and optimization tools for freight, trucking, and last-mile delivery. Helps carriers and shippers reduce miles, improve on-time delivery, and cut costs.
Delivery management platform that unifies carrier networks, automates dispatch, and provides real-time tracking. Specializes in retail and e-commerce last-mile delivery.
Cloud TMS built on Salesforce. Combines brokerage and fleet management in a single platform. Real-time visibility, document management, and carrier integration.
Parcel spend management platform. Analyzes carrier contracts, benchmarks rates, and identifies savings across FedEx, UPS, and regional carriers.
Dynamic multi-carrier rate optimization for e-commerce shippers. Automatically routes each shipment to the best carrier based on cost, speed, and service requirements.
Advanced visibility platform for supply chains. Real-time tracking across all modes — ocean, air, road, and last-mile. Trusted by Fortune 500 shippers and carriers.
Sustainability consulting and fleet electrification advisory. Helps logistics companies transition to zero-emission fleets, optimize charging infrastructure, and meet Scope 3 targets.
Full-service final mile delivery for furniture, appliances, exercise equipment, and other big & bulky items. White-glove delivery, installation, and haul-away nationwide.
Tech-enabled freight brokerage and managed transportation services. Covers all modes including final mile, expedited, and over-dimensional freight.
Regional parcel carrier focused on the Western and Sunbelt US. Overnight delivery to major markets at competitive rates. E-commerce focused with API integration.
World's largest pure-play contract logistics provider. Warehousing, fulfillment, and final mile for retail, e-commerce, and big & bulky customers globally.
Integrated logistics company offering end-to-end supply chain services including ocean freight, air freight, warehousing, and last-mile delivery across 130+ countries.
Startup developing next-generation dispatch and route intelligence. Building AI that adapts to real-time constraints and learns from driver behavior to reduce FADR.
Temperature-controlled packaging and cold chain solutions for last-mile delivery. Reusable PCM-based cold packs for grocery, pharma, and meal kit delivery.
Autonomous indoor and outdoor logistics robots. Warehouse AMRs and sidewalk delivery robots for urban last-mile. Currently in pilot with major US retailers.
Returns logistics platform that makes reverse logistics profitable. Real-time returns routing, refurbishment orchestration, and resale channel integration.
AI-powered delivery verification and fraud prevention. Computer vision-based proof of delivery that reduces claims disputes and protects carrier ratings.
Unified delivery orchestration platform for omnichannel retailers. Same-day, next-day, curbside pickup, and BOPIS management from a single platform.
Post-purchase customer experience platform. Returns management, proactive tracking notifications, and delivery experience optimization for retail brands.
Returns management platform for e-commerce brands. Automates exchanges, keeps revenue in-house, and optimizes return routing to reduce reverse logistics cost.
Returns optimization platform and reverse logistics network. Helps retailers maximize recovery value on returned merchandise through intelligent routing to highest-value channels.
Box-free, label-free return drop-off network with 10,000+ locations. Partners include FedEx, Ulta, and hundreds of e-commerce brands. Owned by UPS.
Tech-forward 3PL specializing in furniture, fitness equipment, and big & bulky retail fulfillment. White-glove delivery, returns handling, and damage reduction programs.
Fulfillment for heavy and oversized products. Guaranteed accuracy and damage-free shipping. Specializes in products over 10 lbs that other 3PLs struggle with.
Final mile carrier focused on furniture, appliances, and big & bulky home delivery. White-glove service, room of choice delivery, assembly, and haul-away.
Regional last-mile carrier for furniture, appliances, and mattresses. Operates in 15+ markets with owner-operator and employee delivery teams.
Electric delivery robots and autonomous vehicle platforms for urban last-mile. Sidewalk delivery bots and small cargo EV carriers for dense urban markets.
Autonomous trucking and delivery automation. Developing Level 4 autonomous trucks for yard management and last-mile freight delivery.
FAA-approved drone delivery network for retail and healthcare last-mile. Commercial drone delivery in multiple US markets with same-day capabilities.
EV fleet management and charging infrastructure platform. Helps carriers and shippers transition to electric delivery vehicles with route optimization for EV constraints.
On-demand delivery platform connecting businesses to local delivery networks. Same-day delivery APIs and routing tools for retailers and distributors.
Canada's largest parcel carrier for e-commerce. Fast last-mile delivery network covering major Canadian markets with competitive rates and real-time tracking.
Fulfillment and delivery services for brands selling outside Amazon. Use Amazon's fulfillment network and delivery capabilities for your own website and other channels.
AI dispatch engine that automates driver assignment and stop sequencing. Reduces dispatcher workload by 80% while improving on-time delivery rates.
Delivery management software with route planning, electronic proof of delivery, and real-time customer notifications. Scales from 10 to 10,000 drivers.
Real-time supply chain visibility platform. Tracks shipments across all modes and carriers, predicts ETAs with AI, and automates exception management.
Shipping platform that helps e-commerce retailers reduce costs and improve delivery speed. Multi-carrier optimization, rate shopping, and carrier performance analytics.
Strategic logistics and supply chain advisory firm. Specializes in carrier network design, last-mile strategy, and logistics technology selection for mid-market companies.
Big & bulky delivery optimization suite. Appointment scheduling, route planning, customer communication, and proof of delivery for furniture and appliance retailers.
Tech-enabled parcel carrier with same-day and next-day delivery in 40+ US markets. Predictable pricing, 99%+ on-time rates, and premium customer experience.
Same-day delivery service for businesses. Professional couriers, real-time tracking, and a simple API. Serves healthcare, retail, and food delivery markets.
Early-stage investor and operator in sustainable last-mile logistics. Backing startups building EV delivery infrastructure, autonomous delivery, and green supply chain tech.
Logistics intelligence platform and media network. Real-time carrier performance benchmarks, market intelligence, and industry news for last-mile operators.
Supply chain and logistics consulting firm. Specializes in last-mile network optimization, 3PL RFPs, and technology implementation for mid-market to enterprise.
Advanced route planning and optimization software. AI-driven scheduling for complex delivery operations including time windows, multi-depot, and big & bulky routing.
Delivery management platform for enterprises. Connects retailers to a network of delivery providers and gives control over the last-mile customer experience.
Modern delivery management software for teams of all sizes. Real-time driver tracking, route optimization, customer notifications, and API-first integration.
